P3's find, qualified: passes rules 1 to 5 (JLCPCB 970 / 967, Digi-Key 5311, Active at TI). Ground 1 passes as for the others. Ground 2: it ranks below TPD6E05U06RVZR because its air discharge is 9 kV (V9's 15 kV passes only by the relaxation), it states no 16 A clamp figure, and it has a VCC pin whose wiring matters. It ranks above the two TPD6E00x parts because its 5.5 V stand-off (VRWM, VBR 9 V min) is a table row and its open-VCC behaviour is in section 6.3.6 and section 8 ('no need to power it'), where TPD6E001RSFR and TPD6E004RSER rest V10, the D+/D- stand-off and CC on application text TI marks as not part of the specification. Ground 4: JLCPCB 970 against 193 and 463. VCC must not be tied to VBUS: CC would then sit above VCC while VBUS is at vSafe0V. Package 2.5 x 6.5 mm, the largest of the four.

requirements.name: IEC 61000-4-2 air
requirements.datasheet: +/-9000 V air-gap discharge (sections 5.2 and 6.3.1): misses 15 kV; the datasheet figure stands by the owner's relaxation of V9

requirements.name: VBUS stand-off
requirements.datasheet: VRWM 5.5 V (MAX column), 'any IO pin to ground', no VCC condition; VBR 9 V min at 1 mA (section 5.5). Section 8: 'passive ESD protection device so there is no need to power it'; section 6.3.6: handles a live signal at the pins with VCC at 0 V. Open point: the absolute maximum (5.1) and recommended (5.3) rows give VIO 0 to VCC, which read literally forbids VBUS at 5.5 V on a pin with VCC open or at 0 V; the datasheet does not settle it. The pass rests on the VRWM row and section 6.3.6

requirements.name: VBUS current
requirements.datasheet: a shunt from each I/O to ground with no series path; it carries no VBUS load current

requirements.name: D+ and D- stand-off
requirements.datasheet: VRWM 5.5 V; IIO 0.01 uA typ, 0.1 uA max at VIO 3.3 V with VCC 5 V; leakage with VCC open is not stated. Same open point as the VBUS row

requirements.name: D+/D- steady voltage (V12)
requirements.datasheet: A passive clamp that activates above VBR, 9 V min (section 6.4): it limits no steady voltage below 9 V; the datasheet figure stands by the owner's relaxation

requirements.name: D+/D- ESD clamping (V12)
requirements.required: 36 V at 16 A TLP, or the datasheet figure
requirements.datasheet: No TLP clamping voltage; RDYN 1.1 Ohm typ at 1 A (section 5.5); Figure 5-3 shows the 8 kV contact clamping waveform, a graph whose peak is not read; IPP 2.5 A at 8/20 us (5.1). 16 A is not given; the datasheet figure stands by the owner's relaxation

requirements.name: D+/D- capacitance (V11)
requirements.datasheet: CIO 0.8 pF typ at VCC 5 V, VIO 2.5 V; no maximum given

requirements.name: D+/D- capacitance matching
requirements.datasheet: No matching figure: 'excellent matching between differential signal pairs' (section 6.1) with no number; the part adds 0.8 pF typ to each line, 1.1 % of the 75 pF share; the line totals are not known (RP2350 Table 1437 gives no pin capacitance)

requirements.name: CC function
requirements.required: CC at vRd up to 2.042 V passes undisturbed, also with VBUS at vSafe0V
requirements.datasheet: With VCC open or at 0 V a blocking diode at the VCC pin stops current from an I/O to the supply pin (section 6.3.6, Ioff); the only conduction paths are the clamp above VBR 9 V min and the lower diode below -0.6 V; leakage 0.1 uA max measured with VCC 5 V, so 0.5 mV across a 5.1 kOhm Rd; leakage with VCC open is not stated. VCC tied to VBUS would put CC above VCC before attach and is not used. Same open point as the VBUS row
